label: Diffuse: end of original phase in long sequences starting with o/z/f/j
explanation: Sparse feature (0.06% of steps). It is enriched at the last 1-2 original tokens and the <DEL> step of long sequences (L=9 holds 66% of mass; orig_idx 8 has 23x lift), in sequences whose first token is o, z, f or j (about 70% of mass), and on inputs m/j/k/b/1/q/3. It also fires weakly late in the copy phase. It never fires at t<3 or in L=3 sequences. The best conjunction of these factors gets dev F1 of only about 0.12 (precision 0.08, recall 0.23), and wider versions reach about 0.58 mass recall at roughly 1% precision. So the feature looks like a specific hidden-state direction built from the token history that these predicates cannot capture. Magnitude is fairly flat (median 0.12, max 0.27), and the top activations are at the final original token/<DEL> of o-initial L=8-9 sequences.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: z, o, f, j, r, p; least: h, d, l, w) and the second original token (most: o, z, c, t, 1, 3; least: h, i, d, u); timing cues that raise it most: to_go=0, L=9 & t=9, L=9.
